- Bringing our own encoder: ~$600 for rental + staff time (~6 hrs prep onsite). More risk.
- Additional AV for keynote (wireless lav + in-room monitor): $850.

Recommendation: pay Atlas $3k for managed streaming and request Atlas to provide an RTMP endpoint AND passthrough recordings (MP4) after event. Negotiate in contract that they will provide a test window on the Friday before the event.

Logan — creative can deliver 4 logo variants (full color, stacked, mono white, mono black) by Apr 28 if we expedite the brief. Also confirm booth artwork (6x3 backdrop PNG) by same date.

Vanessa — for the 30x10 island we need freight estimate; onsite rigging only applies if we request hanging signage. If we stick to floor-standing banners, no rigging required.

If we take the workshop instead of keynote, we should ask for a 10-min fireside within the keynote block as concession.
